MODULUS = 1000000007
array_dp = [0] * 17
array_dp[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 17):
    array_dp[i] = array_dp[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def recursiveSolve(value, depth):
    if depth == 0:
        return 0 if value == 0 else MODULUS
    divisionCount = value // array_dp[depth]
    if value % array_dp[depth] == 0:
        return depth * divisionCount
    optionA = recursiveSolve(abs(value - array_dp[depth] * (divisionCount + 1)), depth - 1) + depth
    optionB = recursiveSolve(value - array_dp[depth] * divisionCount, depth - 1)
    return min(depth * (divisionCount + 1) + optionA - depth, depth * divisionCount + optionB)

input_value = int(input())
print(recursiveSolve(input_value, 16))
